All tests are passing successfully. The repository contains a `slugify` module with two functions (`slugify` and `truncate`) and 5 test cases that all pass correctly:

1. `test_slugify_simple` - Tests basic slugification of "Hello World" to "hello-world"
2. `test_slugify_extra_spaces` - Tests handling of extra spaces in text
3. `test_slugify_punctuation` - Tests removal of punctuation (C++ rocks! → c-rocks)
4. `test_truncate_short` - Tests truncation when text is shorter than the limit
5. `test_truncate_long` - Tests truncation with ellipsis for longer text

The tests are all working as expected, so no fixes are needed.
